title: inspect-binary input
description: A compiled artefact and the means to disassemble it. The toolchain arrives as an adapter file, never as a hardcoded command.

artifact.description: Compiled object, library or executable produced by the build.

disassembly_file.description: A saved text dump. When present the adapter's disassembly command is not run.

adapter_file.description: Device adapter declaring the disassembly command and the symbol patterns. Defaults to the shipped generic-text adapter.

variant.description: Which side of a change this summary describes; the verifier compares the two.

work_group.description: Work-group size the kernel was launched with, in work lanes.

lane_count.description: Problem size in work lanes, used to derive the launch geometry.

scratchpad_capacity_bytes.description: Optional device limit, so a summary can note that a work-group nearly fills it.
